purpose: Test whether the privileged finding benefit can transfer to an image-only observation skill; one bounded HCL-memory-to-SkillOpt update, with frozen diagnosis.
fit: From the previous sealed 64-case diagnosis study, first 16 per CT stratum provide per-view prior descriptions, cleaned reference observations and coverage feedback. No diagnostic gold or diagnosis prompts for the proposer. HCL raw and abstract memories per stratum; one joint bounded append via official SkillOpt patch implementation and at most one format repair.
gate: Other 16 per stratum from the previous study only. Commit only if judged covered references increase in aggregate and diagnostic correct count is nondecreasing in each stratum; strictly positive in at least one of coverage/diagnosis (coverage must strictly improve). Reject malformed or unchanged candidates. Never iterate on gate or confirmation.
confirmation: Next 32 previously unused cases per stratum in original fixed-seed pool, disjoint from all prior 544. Seed vs candidate self-descriptions on the identical first three images. Frozen diagnosis receives same history, options and images; only the generated text changes. No reference or evaluation labels for note writers or diagnostic model. If gate rejects, deployed remains seed; also evaluate frozen rejected candidate diagnostically. Do not promote on confirmation.
metrics: Primary paired correct count and exact McNemar for deployed vs seed. Report candidate vs seed regardless of gate (diagnostic), coverage changes on checked reference observations, contradictions and cases with any rescue or harm. Judges and reference extraction unchanged. No extra VQA or fine-tuning. Both inference policies use three image descriptions of at most 35 words and one diagnostic forward per case. Positive proof-of-concept requires more covered findings and a positive diagnosis net, with primary two-sided p<0.05 for supported diagnostic gain.
